first.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ—the most acute metric decline. Memory_91 shows activation_messaging improved week-one engagement and first meaningful action. Memory_86 demonstrates that improved onboarding completion lifts early adoption. While promotional_pricing (memory_73) addresses competitor pressure, it carries long-term margin risk and doesn't address the core activation regression. Referral_incentive (memory_57) works best on established customers, not relevant to new account activation decline. Enterprise_sales_assist addresses a different segment. Activation messaging is lower-risk, proven, and directly targets the bleeding metric. Verifying memory_91 (activation messaging efficacy) and memory_86 (onboarding/adoption linkage) will confirm the intervention scope before rollout. Standard_experiment scale allows statistical validity while preserving rollback optionality if QoQ trends don't stabilize.
